author: Brian Bowman
title: Royals spiking the competition this season - NewsBreak
text:
By Brian Bowman ,
14 hours ago The Royalton Royals have won a lot of volleyball matches this season.
Royalton improved its record to a stellar 14-4 after a solid 3-0 sweep of Osakis on Tuesday, Sept. 30.
The Royals cruised to set victories of 25-16, 25-11, and 25-16.
Royalton has enjoyed a great season on the court. All the girls on the team have stepped up in a variety of ways to contribute to the team’s success.
“It has been a good year and such a fun year,” Royals’ head coach Morgan Schluttner said. “We have a lot of senior players that have a lot of court and game experience. That’s one of the biggest things that has helped us. They know the game, they're smart, and they stay confident…they have a fight in them and they keep going - they don’t give up and it's so fun to see that.”
Royalton stats leaders in the win included Haylie Wolbeck (12 kills, five set assists), Peyton Soltis (nine kills, 18 digs), Dakarei Rodeski (seven kills), Maddison Albright (15 set assists), Hattie Holm (five set assists) and Mia Zimny (12 digs).
St. Cloud Tech 3 Royalton 0
Royalton lost 3-0 to St. Cloud Tech in three sets (20-25, 13-25 and 23-25) in a rare defeat on Monday, Sept. 29.
Wolbeck and Soltis each had seven kills while Rodeski added four kills. Albright chipped in with 13 set assists and Holm contributed with five set assists.
Soltis had 18 digs and Zimny added 19.
Albright also had two ace serves which gave her 191 in her high school varsity career, breaking the school record.
Royalton 3 Holdingford 1
On Thursday, Sept. 25, Royalton defeated the Holdingford Huskers 3-1 by scores of 20-25, 25-22, 25-22, and 25-23.
Albright achieved her 1,000th career dig during the match. Just two days earlier, Albright also recorded her 1,000th career set assist.
“It is so fun to see her achieve those milestones," Schluttner said. “They were all within a week, which is incredible. It’s all happening within the same week and she is a girl that works very hard and everybody I have, I feel, is a hard worker.”
Against Holdingford, Albright had 11 set assists, 13 kills, and three ace serves.
Royalton’s other individual statistics included Wolbeck (23 digs, 14 kills), Holm (15 set assists), Rodeski (13 kills), Zimny (23 digs), and Soltis (23 digs).
Royalton played at Atwater-Cosmos-Grove City on Thursday, Oct. 2, but no score was available at press time.
The Royals will host Belgrade-Brooten-Elrosa on Thursday, Oct. 9. Game time is 7 p.m.
